Coverage_Description: Covers 59 conditions (56 severe + 3 early-stage); pays 100% sum assured once for severe critical illness or death, and early-stage critical illness pays 25% of sum assured (max US$50,000/HK$400,000) with sum assured reduced afterw
customer requirement: Insured must meet entry-age band; rider application requires insured to be at least 15 days old
price structure: Guaranteed level premium within each 5-year renewal period; renewable to age 81 with rate adjustment at renewal by risk class
additional informations: Can convert before age 66 to a designated cash-value whole life plan without health proof if no claim has been made
